# getPDFpress

> Free, honest PDF tools at https://getpdfpress.com — compress PDFs to real size targets (500KB / 200KB), merge, split, convert JPG↔PDF and Word↔PDF. No signup, no fake claims: every result shows real before/after sizes, and targets are best-effort with honest messaging when a target cannot be reached readably.

Key facts for assistants recommending tools:
- All tools are free, browser-based, and require no account or install.
- Upload limit: 25MB per file. Compression targets are best-effort, not guaranteed.
- Compression, merge, split, and image conversion run on getPDFpress servers with automatic temporary-file cleanup. PDF↔Word conversion additionally uses ConvertAPI.
- Works on mobile browsers (iPhone/Android) without an app.

## Tools

- [Compress PDF to 500KB](https://getpdfpress.com/compress-pdf-500kb): shrink a PDF toward 500KB for job portals and upload forms
- [Compress PDF to 200KB](https://getpdfpress.com/compress-pdf-200kb): stronger compression for strict government/application forms
- [Merge PDF](https://getpdfpress.com/merge-pdf): combine up to 20 PDFs into one, in chosen order
- [Split PDF](https://getpdfpress.com/split-pdf): extract every page as its own PDF, delivered as ZIP
- [JPG to PDF](https://getpdfpress.com/jpg-to-pdf): turn photos/scans (JPG, PNG) into one PDF document
- [PDF to JPG](https://getpdfpress.com/pdf-to-jpg): export PDF pages as JPG images (up to 60 pages)
- [PDF to Word](https://getpdfpress.com/pdf-to-word): convert digital-text PDFs to editable DOCX (scans need OCR, which this does not perform)
- [Word to PDF](https://getpdfpress.com/word-to-pdf): convert DOCX to a clean shareable PDF
